title: Listening Drill — Screen printing — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Screen printing — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on screen printing last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with smudged ink. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: blocked screen.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of paper alignment so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow cotton apron instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the print technician before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
